title: Dennis Brown Documentary Film - Associate Producer/Script-writer/Researcher
html:
Dennis Emanuel Brown often described as the 'Crown Prince of Reggae' was a prolific Jamaican artiste who toured the world with his countless hits. From Money In My Pocket, to Wolf And Leopards, Love Has Found Its Way and Promised Land, he spanned multiple decades of music with his unique voice.

I worked on the Dennis Brown: The Crown Prince of Reggae; the Man and the Music documentary as associate producer, script-writer and researcher. I was part of the initial research group, as well as writing the storyboard and timeline, contacting interviewees, undertaking film interviews, writing the films script and some narration, plus, I supported the editing process.

Commissioned by the Ministry of Culture, Gender, Entertainment and Sport in Jamaica it was premiered on July 1st 2021. You can view the local media's reception below and in the video.

title: CVMTV - Lifestyle & Entertainment Producer, Reporter, Presenter
html:
I started April 2020, in the middle of the COVID-19 pandemic. I was the only journalist that attended the intimate Beenie Man and Bounty Killer's VERZUZ battle streamed to over 1/4 million people in May 2020.

I am responsible for producing (ideating, guest-getting, interviewing, writing scripts) and presenting the daily packages:

Social media - 2 mins, a look at social media comments on a news worthy topic across Twitter, Facebook, Instagram.

Lifestyle & Entertainment - 4 mins, covering lifestyle topics of Career/Academia, Health, Fashion, Home/Garden, Food/Wine; as well as breaking entertainment news, interviews, and music charts or weekly 'Tune Tracking'.

Sunrise Entertainment - 5 mins, an entertainment specific package for the morning programme covering breaking news, interviews with upcoming artistes, actors etc. and keeping a pulse on local and international entertainment trends.

I also produce and present the weekend (Sat/Sun) entertainment packages titled:

E-Live - 5 mins, entertainment show typically featuring a candid look at musicians, singers, actors or those of note with a link to the entertainment industry. Inc. Ziggy Marley, Kabaka Pyramid, Chaka Demus, Lila Ike, Gramps Morgan, Spragga Benz, Maxi Priest, Dexta Daps.

title: Student Lifestart
html:
A project in partnership with Virgin Money and Virgin LifeStart, I was lucky to be part of this incredible project from the Oct 2017 until April 2019. Our goal was to engage students, encouraging them to enter into challenges and learn real-life business skills, whilst having opportunities to win money, internships and trips to America.

Challenge partners included; JCDecaux, Virgin Galactic Unite, Samsung, Sony Pictures, and Virgin Money Giving. With winners being offered full-time employment, as well as building an active online community via email and Facebook and organising day long university events, called 'LifeStartFests' in London and Bangor.

I was part of the project from launch, joining in my final year of study. My role included everything from social media management and strategy, online presenting, event hosting and moderating, copy-writing, editing, filming, interviews etc.

Although the decision was taken to close the website, I learnt a huge amount from working on the project and I am enthusiastic of finding projects like this in the future!

You can read a selection of the blog-posts I wrote for the site via Writing but I also managed the social media strategy, our student reporters as well as presenting and producing video content.
